verses.original: Ἀποθέμενοι οὖν πᾶσαν κακίαν καὶ πάντα δόλον καὶ ὑποκρίσεις καὶ φθόνους καὶ πάσας καταλαλιάς
verses.transliteration: Apothemenoi oun pasan kakian kai panta dolon kai hypokriseis kai phthonous kai pasas katalalias
verses.literal: Rid yourselves therefore {of} all malice - - deceit - hypocrisy - envy and - slander

verses.original: ὡς ἀρτιγέννητα βρέφη ἐπιποθήσατε τὸ ἄδολον λογικὸν γάλα ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ αὐξηθῆτε εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: hōs artigennēta brephē epipothēsate to adolon logikon gala hina en autō auxēthēte eis sōtērian
verses.literal: Like newborn babies crave - pure spiritual milk so that by it you may grow up in [your] salvation

verses.original: εἰ ἐγεύσασθε ὅτι ὁ Κύριος χρηστὸς
verses.transliteration: ei egeusasthe hoti ho Kyrios chrēstos
verses.literal: now that you have tasted that the Lord [is] good

verses.original: προσερχόμενοι Πρὸς ὃν ζῶντα λίθον μὲν ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων δὲ ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον Θεῷ παρὰ
verses.transliteration: proserchomenoi Pros hon zōnta lithon men apodedokimasmenon hypo anthrōpōn de eklekton entimon Theō para
verses.literal: As you come to [Him] [the] living stone - rejected by men but chosen [and] precious in God’s sight

verses.original: αὐτοὶ καὶ ὡς ζῶντες λίθοι οἰκοδομεῖσθε πνευματικὸς οἶκος εἰς ἅγιον ἱεράτευμα ἀνενέγκαι πνευματικὰς θυσίας εὐπροσδέκτους τῷ Θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: autoi kai hōs zōntes lithoi oikodomeisthe pneumatikos oikos eis hagion hierateuma anenenkai pneumatikas thysias euprosdektous tō Theō dia Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: you also like living stones are being built into a spiritual house to [be] a holy priesthood offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable - to God through Jesus Christ

verses.original: διότι περιέχει ἐν γραφῇ Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον ἀκρογωνιαῖον καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ
verses.transliteration: dioti periechei en graphē Idou tithēmi en Siōn lithon eklekton entimon akrogōniaion kai ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou mē kataischynthē
verses.literal: For it stands in Scripture See I lay in Zion a stone a chosen [and] precious cornerstone and the [one who] believes in Him vvv vvv will never be put to shame

verses.original: Ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν οὖν ἡ τιμὴ δὲ ἀπιστοῦσιν Λίθος ὃν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες ἀπεδοκίμασαν οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας
verses.transliteration: Hymin tois pisteuousin oun hē timē de apistousin Lithos hon hoi oikodomountes apedokimasan houtos egenēthē eis kephalēn gōnias
verses.literal: To you who believe then [this stone] is precious But [to those who] do not believe [The] stone - the builders rejected - has become . . . vvv the cornerstone

verses.original: Καὶ Λίθος προσκόμματος καὶ πέτρα σκανδάλου Οἳ προσκόπτουσιν ἀπειθοῦντες τῷ λόγῳ καὶ εἰς ὃ ἐτέθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai Lithos proskommatos kai petra skandalou Hoi proskoptousin apeithountes tō logō kai eis ho etethēsan
verses.literal: and A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense [They] stumble [because] they disobey the word and to [this] they were appointed

verses.original: δὲ Ὑμεῖς ἐκλεκτόν γένος βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα ἅγιον ἔθνος λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν ὅπως ἐξαγγείλητε τὰς ἀρετὰς τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐκ σκότους εἰς αὐτοῦ θαυμαστὸν τὸ φῶς
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis eklekton genos basileion hierateuma hagion ethnos laos eis peripoiēsin hopōs exangeilēte tas aretas tou kalesantos hymas ek skotous eis autou thaumaston to phōs
verses.literal: But you [are] a chosen people a royal priesthood a holy nation a people for [God’s own] possession to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous - light

verses.original: ποτε οἵ οὐ λαὸς δὲ νῦν λαὸς Θεοῦ οἱ οὐκ ἠλεημένοι δὲ νῦν ἐλεηθέντες
verses.transliteration: pote hoi ou laos de nyn laos Theou hoi ouk ēleēmenoi de nyn eleēthentes
verses.literal: Once [you were] not a people but now [you are] [the] people of God [once you] vvv had not received mercy but now you have received mercy

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί παρακαλῶ ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν σαρκικῶν αἵτινες στρατεύονται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi parakalō hōs paroikous kai parepidēmous apechesthai tōn epithymiōn sarkikōn haitines strateuontai kata tēs psychēs
verses.literal: Beloved I urge [you] as foreigners and exiles to abstain from [the] desires of the flesh which war against [your] soul

verses.original: τὴν ἔχοντες ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν καλήν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλοῦσιν ὑμῶν ὡς κακοποιῶν ἐκ ἐποπτεύοντες τῶν καλῶν ἔργων δοξάσωσιν τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς
verses.transliteration: tēn echontes anastrophēn hymōn kalēn en tois ethnesin hina en hō katalalousin hymōn hōs kakopoiōn ek epopteuontes tōn kalōn ergōn doxasōsin ton Theon en hēmera episkopēs
verses.literal: - Conduct . . . yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that vvv though they slander you as evildoers - they may see [your] good deeds [and] glorify - God on [the] day He visits us

verses.original: Ὑποτάγητε τὸν Κύριον διὰ πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κτίσει εἴτε βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι
verses.transliteration: Hypotagēte ton Kyrion dia pasē anthrōpinē ktisei eite basilei hōs hyperechonti
verses.literal: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution whether to [the] king as the supreme [authority]

verses.original: εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς πεμπομένοις δι’ αὐτοῦ εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν δὲ ἔπαινον ἀγαθοποιῶν
verses.transliteration: eite hēgemosin hōs pempomenois di’ autou eis ekdikēsin kakopoiōn de epainon agathopoiōn
verses.literal: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right

verses.original: ὅτι ἐστὶν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ θέλημα οὕτως ἀγαθοποιοῦντας φιμοῦν τὴν ἀγνωσίαν ἀφρόνων τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: hoti estin tou Theou to thelēma houtōs agathopoiountas phimoun tēn agnōsian aphronōn tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: For it is vvv God’s - will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish - men

verses.original: ὡς ἐλεύθεροι καὶ μὴ ἔχοντες τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ὡς ἐπικάλυμμα τῆς κακίας ἀλλ’ ὡς δοῦλοι Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōs eleutheroi kai mē echontes tēn eleutherian hōs epikalymma tēs kakias all’ hōs douloi Theou
verses.literal: [Live] in freedom [but] vvv do not use [your] freedom as a cover-up for evil - [live] as servants of God

verses.original: τιμήσατε Πάντας ἀγαπᾶτε τὴν ἀδελφότητα φοβεῖσθε τὸν Θεὸν τιμᾶτε τὸν βασιλέα
verses.transliteration: timēsate Pantas agapate tēn adelphotēta phobeisthe ton Theon timate ton basilea
verses.literal: Treat everyone with high regard . . . Love the brotherhood [of believers] fear - God honor the king

verses.original: Οἱ οἰκέται ὑποτασσόμενοι τοῖς δεσπόταις ἐν παντὶ φόβῳ οὐ μόνον τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐπιεικέσιν ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς σκολιοῖς
verses.transliteration: Hoi oiketai hypotassomenoi tois despotais en panti phobō ou monon tois agathois kai epieikesin alla kai tois skoliois
verses.literal: - Servants submit yourselves to [your] masters with all respect not only to those who [are] good and gentle but even to those who [are] unreasonable

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ τις ὑποφέρει λύπας ἀδίκως πάσχων διὰ συνείδησιν Θεοῦ τοῦτο χάρις
verses.transliteration: gar ei tis hypopherei lypas adikōs paschōn dia syneidēsin Theou touto charis
verses.literal: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God this is to be commended

verses.original: γὰρ ποῖον κλέος εἰ κολαφιζόμενοι ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ ὑπομενεῖτε ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ πάσχοντες ἀγαθοποιοῦντες ὑπομενεῖτε τοῦτο χάρις παρὰ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar poion kleos ei kolaphizomenoi hamartanontes kai hypomeneite all’ ei kai paschontes agathopoiountes hypomeneite touto charis para Theō
verses.literal: - How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure [it] But if - you suffer for doing good [and] you endure [it] this [is] commendable before God

verses.original: γὰρ Εἰς τοῦτο ἐκλήθητε ὅτι Χριστὸς καὶ ἔπαθεν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ὑπολιμπάνων ὑμῖν ὑπογραμμὸν ἵνα ἐπακολουθήσητε αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἴχνεσιν
verses.transliteration: gar Eis touto eklēthēte hoti Christos kai epathen hyper hymōn hypolimpanōn hymin hypogrammon hina epakolouthēsēte autou tois ichnesin
verses.literal: For to this . . . you were called because Christ also suffered for you leaving you an example that you should follow in His - footsteps

verses.original: Ὃς ἐποίησεν οὐκ ἁμαρτίαν οὐδὲ δόλος εὑρέθη ἐν αὐτοῦ τῷ στόματι
verses.transliteration: Hos epoiēsen ouk hamartian oude dolos heurethē en autou tō stomati
verses.literal: He committed no sin [and] no deceit was found in His - mouth

verses.original: ὃς λοιδορούμενος οὐκ ἀντελοιδόρει πάσχων οὐκ ἠπείλει δὲ παρεδίδου τῷ κρίνοντι δικαίως
verses.transliteration: hos loidoroumenos ouk anteloidorei paschōn ouk ēpeilei de paredidou tō krinonti dikaiōs
verses.literal: vvv When they heaped abuse on Him vvv He did not retaliate when He suffered vvv He made no threats but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly

verses.original: ὃς αὐτὸς ἀνήνεγκεν ἡμῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἐν αὐτοῦ τῷ σώματι ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον ἵνα ἀπογενόμενοι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ζήσωμεν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ Οὗ τῷ μώλωπι ἰάθητε
verses.transliteration: hos autos anēnenken hēmōn tas hamartias en autou tō sōmati epi to xylon hina apogenomenoi tais hamartiais zēsōmen tē dikaiosynē Hou tō mōlōpi iathēte
verses.literal: [He] Himself bore our - sins in His - body on the tree so that we might die - to sin [and] live - to righteousness By [His] - stripes you are healed

verses.original: γὰρ Ἦτε ὡς πρόβατα πλανώμενοι ἀλλὰ νῦν ἐπεστράφητε ἐπὶ τὸν Ποιμένα καὶ Ἐπίσκοπον τῶν ὑμῶν ψυχῶν
verses.transliteration: gar Ēte hōs probata planōmenoi alla nyn epestraphēte epi ton Poimena kai Episkopon tōn hymōn psychōn
verses.literal: For you were like sheep going astray but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls
